_comment: Authorization resource-and-operation contract. Exact operation ids are the seed source of truth. name is a concise display label; description is optional explanatory text. parent_type + parent_operation are an explicit bkn-safe generic fallback mapping only: an empty parent_operation means no generic inheritance, never same-name inheritance by convention. requires contains same-resource prerequisites that bkn-safe normalizes into allow grants and enforces at runtime. Business services may retain separately documented checks on another resource; do not encode those as parent_operation unless bkn-safe owns the fallback. NOTE: view (execution factory / flow automation) and view_detail (Vega / BKN) are distinct operation ids. Role-to-permission grants are maintained in grants.json.
